model: LiveKit conv-attention medium, trained on Piper LibriTTS (904 EN speakers x SLERP) + ACAV100M negatives + MIT RIRs

eval_methodology.positives: 500 synthetic 'hey gemma' clips, 25 Piper voices held out from training, 13 languages
eval_methodology.negatives: LibriSpeech test-clean + dev-clean, ~7.7h total measured across two runs
eval_methodology.pad_fix: wake phrase must be at END of 2s window (LiveKit pads zeros at start); eval pads short clips at start accordingly
eval_methodology.scoring: sliding 2s window, hop 0.5s, max score per clip

notes: First substantial wake-word success across 7 sprints. Dutch/Vietnamese/Mandarin still ~0 recall (phonetically distant from EN training corpus). Future work: add multilingual TTS coverage for those, or accept EN/Romance/Slavic coverage as the universal floor.
